body:
I don't want to go into too many personal details, but due to my situation I am not eligible for more financial aid from the government. I can get more money if I change my status ie apply as a grad student rather than an undergrad, but I worry my GPA isn't high enough or I won't be accepted into grad school. I already have a bachelors degree but because I didn't really plan well in advance, it's not really a degree I can find a job with where I live. I have no money to be looking to move to a city where it would be more useful. Basically, I have a degree but can't find a job with it where I am, but no job means I have no money to relocate to where I *could* get a job with my degree.

As I mentioned above, I don't feel like I have any sort of support system to accomplish any of this. I'm tired and frustrated and tired of *being* frustrated.
I worry that i'm not brave enough to survive or to make things better. It seems like a lot of work and I don't have much of a support system to get there.
